Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-09-29T14:02Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Two more holds.** Two more cards now wait on this pin move, each re-derived to `Blocked-by: #20638` in this round:

| held card | the pin must contain … | `compare <commit>...dd3f7e1be356` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| #20313 | `ae582b70a`, PR objectui#11089 (objectui#11026) | `behind`, `behind_by=92` |
| #20299 | `5b2ea17570`, PR objectui#11098 (objectui#11027) | `behind`, `behind_by=96` |

Unblocks: #20287, #20578, #20293, #20313, #20299

**The target rule is unchanged:** any objectui `main` commit that contains every listed commit. objectui `main` at claim time contains all five.

## Triage: regraded **p2 → p1**. This bump now carries the fix for a p1 17.5.0 regression into objectstack's next release, so it waits for PR objectui#11119, then lands before that release

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-09-29T16:00Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **objectui#11105 (p1)** is a 17.5.0 regression: a server-grouped grid with object `columns` errors in every group, measured on hotcrm's default Products, Knowledge Articles and Forecasts lists. Its fix is PR objectui#11119, in flight.
- **`@objectstack/console` bundles objectui at `.objectui-sha`,** so the fix reaches objectstack's next release only through this bump. That is why this card takes the regression's ceiling.
- **The target rule gains one row:** the pin must also contain PR objectui#11119's merge. So take the pin **after** it merges, and land this before the maintainer merges the next Version Packages PR.
- **The maintainer has called the follow-up release** (chat ruling, recorded on #20622). This card is on the triage seat's pre-release checklist.

## Unlock scan: this bump's last precondition is met — take it now

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-09-29T18:08Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **PR objectui#11119 merged** at 2026-09-29T16:12Z as `3100bef65c`. It is the fix for objectui#11105's p1 grouped-grid regression that this bump must carry (`5893881742`).
- **The target rule is unchanged:** any objectui `main` commit that contains all six of `a5841be351`, `99878d8e3a`, `49f76725aa`, `ae582b70a`, `5b2ea17570` and `3100bef65c`. objectui `main` at claim time does.
- **It is on the release path.** Two of the maintainer's other release items have landed (#20622, #20649). This p1 is still `pm:queue` and unclaimed, and it must land before the next Version Packages merge.

**PR shape**
- Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #20638`, `Clause-②: no`, assignee `os-tesla`.
- 20 files (+565 / −166): `.objectui-sha`, the sdui manifest and its record, the lockstep file, the pin-citation re-measure in `packages/spec/src` (with the regenerated `registry.ts` and `view.mdx`), and two changesets (`@objectstack/console` `minor`, `@objectstack/spec` `patch`).
- NOT governed; 731 changed lines, under the human-merge threshold.

**What it does**
- The console pin moves `dd3f7e1be356` → `db11afd4967c`, which is on objectui `main` and ships `@object-ui/console` 17.6.0.
- The new pin contains all six target commits, including `3100bef65c`, the objectui#11105 p1 fix this bump carries into the next release.
- The pin read-points (the lockstep and 49 spec citations) are re-measured at the new pin, not re-labelled.
- **The ADR-0087 disposition is the maintainer's ruling:** `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, worded as in #20436 (claim `5903537467`).

**This round**
- The disposition line replaced the placeholder: +20 / −1 in one file.
- `origin/main` merged at `ef6276c0e9` through `os-regen-merge.sh`, with no regeneration owed.
- **The boot the card's Acceptance requires is now recorded:** `build-console.sh` at the new pin, a zero-user database, `/setup` registration through to the Showcase and Setup pages, with 0 page errors, 0 `TypeError` and 0 5xx.
- 125 of 125 derived gates exit 0. The seat's own reading of the spec half: every non-comment change is recorded data (the lockstep), rationale-string text in the six `18.*-unit-in-key.ts` entries, or the `FormField.span` describe sentence.

**At-tier contract review:** `5904174450` on the PR, at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, on this head — **PASS**.
- The six target commits are contained, and the pin is on objectui `main`.
- The spec and sdui-parser half is text only.
- The re-measured numbers were re-taken at the pin, including the falsified-then-qualified `ListMapConfigSchema` record, whose new wording is true.
- The console changeset's derivation reproduces (99 changesets, no `major` → `minor`). Every sentence of the ADR-0087 reason block holds, including "objectui's own package surfaces" (`@object-ui/types`, `core`, `plugin-dashboard`).
- The spec `patch` and `Clause-②: no` are right. The merge lost nothing, and the boot meets the Acceptance as #20436 set it.
- The seat checked the review's transcript: served at tier, read-only, 0 MCP calls, and one write (its comment).

**Deviations, adopted**
- The console build pointed `OBJECTUI_ROOT` at a private objectui source carrying the pin, so the shared clone was not touched.
- `main` moved after the merge (`c9c182ed14` adds a migration entry to `registry.ts`). The review confirms it is text-disjoint, and the queue build judges the combination.
- The PR body was stale. The seat applied the dev's five `pr_body_lines` edits and read them back identical, because the body becomes the landing commit's message.
